Author: Vivek Singh Thakur

sentences.text: The Principal Secretary (Tourisim & CA) Govt. of H.P. and others CWP No. 7846 of 2023 10.09.2024
Present: Ms. Ritta Goswami, Sr. Advocate with Ms. Komal Chaudhary and Ms. Rekha Thakur, Advocates for the petitioner.
Mr Pranay Pratap Singh, Additional Advocate General, for respondents No.1 and 2.
Mr. Neeraj Gupta, Sr. Advocate with Ms. Rinki Kashmiri, Advocate, for respondents No.3 and 4.

Mr.
Balram Sharma, Deputy Solicitor General of India, for respondents No.5.
Ms. Sneh Bhimta, Advocate vice Ms. Shreya Chauhan, Advocate for respondent No.6.

Learned counsel for petitioner has placed on record Public Notice dated 8th September, 2024 issued by the Collector- cum-Land Acquisition Officer Kangra under Section 21 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 whereby Public Notice has been given for intimating all concerned that the Government intends to take possession of land in reference.
According to her, the said Notice is in violation to the undertaking given by respondents/State as recorded in order dated 7th December, 2023 of this Court and order dated 7 th March, 2024 passed by the Supreme Court.
In order dated 7th December, 2023, passed by this High Court, it was recorded as under:-
"Learned Advocate General assures that till the next date of hearing, the respondents will not .
dispossess anybody from the land, which is forming part of notification issued under Section 11(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, notified for expansion of Gaggal (Kangra) Airport, and that no structure located within the land, which is subject matter of the said notification, will be demolished.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: "During the course of the hearing Mr. Kapil Sibal, senior counsel appearing on behalf of the State of Himachal Pradesh has assured the Court that the statement which was made by the Advocate General before the High Court shall continue to remain in operation in the meantime, unless the Court is moved for appropriate modification in view of any change in circumstances.
We take the assurance on the record."

Learned Additional Advocate General appearing for State submits that no action has been taken or initiated by respondents/State in violation of undertaking given to Court as no- one is being dispossessed as on date and no structure located in the land, in reference, is being demolished.

He has further stated that Public Notice dated 8.9.2024 is a part of process which has been permitted to be continued and this Notice does not mean taking of possession or demolition of structure, rather it provides dates for public hearing to the persons of affected area and that will go, as .
from aforesaid Public Notice, till 11th November, 2024.
In view of submissions made by learned Additional Advocate General on behalf of respondents/State, no further order is required to be passed at this stage.

Learned counsel for petitioner, referring the location plan, placed on record as Annexure P-7, has submitted that proposed extension of Airport is covering maximum area where Four-Lane has been constructed by spending huge money and it is thickly populated, whereas alternative sites reflected in aforesaid location plan indicates that extension on said alternative site would cause lesser displacement and wastage of public exchequer.
For request of learned Additional Advocate General, matter is adjourned for tomorrow i.e. 11th September, 2024 for continuation in order to enable him to respond to aforesaid submissions.
List on 11th September, 2024.
(Vivek Singh Thakur)

Judge  September 10, 2024 (Ranjan Sharma)
